one_line: The monarch and first Viceroy who oversaw the transfer of Indian rule from the East India Company to the British Crown after 1858.

appearance.age_look: Queen Victoria appears as a dignified woman in her late thirties with a solid, regal build; Lord Canning as a tall, lean man in his mid-forties with a composed posture.
appearance.face: Victoria has a round, pale face with soft cheeks, small mouth, straight nose, dark steady eyes and a calm, slightly solemn default expression; Canning has an oval face, fair complexion, high forehead, neatly trimmed brown sideburns, sharp nose and thoughtful, serious eyes with a reserved expression.
appearance.hair: Victoria’s dark brown hair is parted in the centre, smoothed back and coiled into a low bun, mostly covered by a small black bonnet with a short veil and simple trim; Canning’s medium-brown hair is combed back from the forehead, kept short and tidy, without headwear.
appearance.costume: Queen Victoria wears an 1850s black silk day dress with a fitted bodice, high modest neckline with white lace collar, long sleeves with lace cuffs, and a wide bell-shaped skirt supported by unseen crinoline, the dress plain but trimmed with narrow black braid; over it she has a short black silk mantle with subtle quilting, a long white lace capeline draped over her shoulders, and a simple long chain with a small oval locket; Lord Canning wears a mid-19th-century British official’s dark navy frock coat reaching mid-thigh with tailored waist and covered buttons, a cream waistcoat beneath, high-collared white shirt with a black cravat tied in a neat knot, straight dark grey trousers, and polished black leather shoes, his outfit clean and unadorned except for the official sash described below.
appearance.signature: Victoria holds a rolled parchment bearing the Proclamation in one gloved hand; Canning wears a deep red ceremonial sash diagonally over his frock coat and holds a closed leather dispatch case symbolising the new office of Viceroy and Secretary of State administration.

ref_desc: Queen Victoria in black 1850s silk dress, lace collar and bonnet with low bun hair stands beside Lord Canning in dark navy frock coat, cream waistcoat and red ceremonial sash, holding a rolled parchment and leather dispatch case in a black, white and deep red palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Queen Victoria and Lord Canning standing side by side: Victoria as a round-faced, pale woman in her late thirties with dark brown hair parted and coiled in a low bun under a small black bonnet, calm and solemn, wearing an 1850s black silk day dress with fitted bodice, high modest neckline, white lace collar, long sleeves with lace cuffs, and a wide bell-shaped skirt, the dress plain with narrow black braid trim, covered by a short black quilted mantle and a long white lace capeline over her shoulders, holding a rolled parchment in one gloved hand; Canning as a tall, lean man in his mid-forties with an oval, fair face, high forehead, neatly trimmed brown sideburns, serious eyes and short tidy hair combed back, dressed in a dark navy frock coat with tailored waist and covered buttons over a cream waistcoat and high-collared white shirt with a simple black cravat, straight dark grey trousers and black leather shoes, wearing a deep red ceremonial sash diagonally across his chest and holding a closed brown leather dispatch case at his side; keep proportions shonen-anime stylised but costumes, hair and accessories historically grounded, with dominant colours black, white, dark navy, dark grey and deep red against a neutral background that clearly shows their outfits head to toe.
